meta.name: Election Path historical generic-ballot model
meta.source: RealClearPolling PDF exports supplied by the user
meta.marginConvention: Democratic margin positive; Republican margin negative
meta.method: For each historical cycle and snapshot date, average all individual polls whose fieldwork ended in the trailing 14 days. Subtract that polling margin from the cycle's final national House popular-vote margin. The forecast correction is the equal-weight mean of those cycle-level corrections.
